cash_preference: Reduce unnecessary idle cash and compare higher investment exposure within the drawdown and leverage constraints.
short_history_etf_policy: Exclude newly listed ETFs from primary research when insufficient history blocks a meaningful comparison.

historical_discovery_policy.universe: point-in-time eligible stocks only; ETFs excluded
historical_discovery_policy.rediscovery: rebuild the eligible universe on every historical trading day
historical_discovery_policy.ranking: raw numeric close-session volume top 20 with deterministic symbol tie-break
historical_discovery_policy.entry: close above prior completed 20-session high and volume above prior completed 20-session average; fill next tradable open
historical_discovery_policy.exit: close below SMA20 for two consecutive sessions; fill next tradable open
historical_discovery_policy.drawdown_reference: KRW running peak NAV; next-open liquidation and no re-entry during the run
historical_discovery_policy.us_fx: one initial KRW/USD conversion with spread, then native USD cash and trades with USD and KRW curves
historical_discovery_policy.execution: research and simulation only; no live or paper activation

request_stages.pilot: exactly one calendar year ending on the requested end date
request_stages.final: exactly three calendar years ending on the requested end date

staged_market_research_policy.leap_day: anniversary in a non-leap year is February 28
staged_market_research_policy.final_gate: same market completed ready pilot with matching current policy, execution assumptions, and canonical data contract hash
staged_market_research_policy.pilot_reference: pilot requires no reference; final requires pilot_run_id; legacy rows remain legacy
staged_market_research_policy.warmup: exactly twenty completed sessions before evaluation; no warmup trades, equity, or positions
staged_market_research_policy.period_integrity: pilot and final collect their own PIT data; period input hashes differ and today-candidate backfill is forbidden
staged_market_research_policy.production: missing provider coverage remains insufficient and never executable

approximate_market_data_policy.grade: approximate results are for personal investment judgment and never strict PIT verified
approximate_market_data_policy.historical_universe: date-specific KRX/public lists or Alpha Vantage LISTING_STATUS(date active/delisted); current candidates are forbidden
approximate_market_data_policy.sample: fixed seed, max 100 sampled symbols per market and max 400 unique source symbols
approximate_market_data_policy.contracts: pilot pool is fixed through its end date; final must match market, grade, policy, assumptions, source, pool, normalization, missing-data, corporate-action, and FX contracts
approximate_market_data_policy.missing_data: exclude non-held missing bars with coverage counts; held missing bars use last known mark with age/estimated caveat and no invented liquidation
approximate_market_data_policy.web: web reads prepared bounded cache only; import-file validates a prepared response; network collection is CLI-only
approximate_market_data_policy.network_collection: CLI collect may fetch bounded KRX official daily GET, Alpha Vantage, Yahoo, and FRED responses into secret-free resumable cache; missing keys, partial responses, malformed responses, and unresolved actions remain insufficient
approximate_market_data_policy.credentials: missing KRX or Alpha Vantage credentials remain explicitly unavailable

preregistration.budget: bounded compute, data, and artifact budgets fixed before execution
preregistration.period: bounded IS, separate validation, chronological walk-forward, and one untouched OOS period fixed before execution
preregistration.required_return: candidate-specific required return fixed before execution; failure blocks stress and PAPER
